name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded Smith bar across your hips.
Unrack the bar and drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is parallel.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and re-rack the bar when done.
image_prompt_scene: With the upper back on a bench and the Smith bar across the hips.
